'''Yerla Tasso''' was a famed [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]] whose work was exhibited but stolen from a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] museum. An anonymous art dealer later sold the art on a secret auction.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Statue of Limitations}}</ref>
